system.description:
You must have «Resurrection» in order to acquire this skill. You may immediately use «Resurrection» with [Range: 6 Sq.]

(SR2): When you use this skill, the target of «Resurrection» gains [Regen: (Magic Power) + (Recovery) + 10].

Magic that revives allies and uses pulsation recovery magic at the same time. A resurrection magic unique to the <Forest Curse> that converges the abundant vitality of nature into a single point and activates it.
